title: Add discount codes to the cart
description:
Customers should be able to enter a discount code at checkout.

- `total(items, code)` takes an optional code; without one, totals work as today.
- `SAVE10` takes 10% off the cart total.
- An unknown code throws `Error('unknown code: <code>')`.
- Amounts must follow our money rules (see the knowledge base): no rounding before the discount.

Example: one line of price 0.10 × qty 3 with SAVE10 → 0.27.
